doc.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15

title: Freddie Small, blind clarinetist and memory
summary: Rene recommends Freddie Small, a blind former Rena player with a good memory, as a source of history.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
